mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the reflexes was most worthwhile because the result linked the sensors to a recognizable action: keeping a friend's image steadier while turning the head.

leastWorthwhile.text: Grouping the organs and adding their nerve pathways felt repetitive; both results mainly confirmed the combinations without adding much explanation.

surprise.text: The weighted sensors respond both to gravity and to changes in straight-line motion; the tilt and forward-motion comparison clarified that relationship.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although connecting the organs to nerves and then to the body felt like two predictable assembly steps. The offered combinations supplied compatibility rather than letting me discover it.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see another familiar action explained through body systems, although I would hope for more meaningful choices and fewer repetitive assembly steps.
